name: Serve Robotics
notes: recall addition: Found by the exit-side EDGAR full-text sweep: a 2025 Schedule 13G naming a Khosla vehicle on the Postmates spin-out's stock. A 13G on a company the firm entered privately is fund-side ownership evidence, not a post-IPO crossover purchase — flagged for the A/B pass to confirm which. (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=serve+robotics&type=SC+13G); not_member (agent): CORRECTED from member. The only evidence is a 2025 Schedule 13G, filed after Serve Robotics was already listed — and COLLECTION.md §1's standing rule is explicit that a position which first appears as a post-IPO 13G, never through a venture round, is not_member crossover treasury rather than portfolio membership. Serve was a 2021 Postmates spin-out backed by Uber and Wavemaker; no Khosla venture round into it appears in any layer. Flagging the row while publishing it as a member would have been the Hawthorne Labs mistake — an unsupported assertion carried by a flag. If a pre-listing Khosla round is ever documented, the ledger amends and the row returns on the next rebuild.
